notes: E1 figures (256 villages, 230 MSMEs, 2,081 beneficiaries) come from the infographic on the same printed page 9 as the quoted paragraph, but the text was extracted as a separate chunk. If figure verification fails, Community and Entrepreneurship should go to human review (they would likely fall to 2). The report also cites 142,625 'Community Livelihood Program Beneficiaries' (infographic) and 'at least 142 thousand people' benefiting directly from business activities (Board report). These were not recorded as a separate record because the narrative ties the figure to business activities generally and it overlaps E1/E2. The company received an 'Education for All Advocate' award (Republika ESG Now Awards 2025). Contradiction: D&I for Leaders is described as implemented, but the AMDI training table shows D&I training of 8 batches/26 employees in 2024 and none in 2025. Status is kept current per the narrative and flagged here. Gender diversity and women-in-leadership percentages (32.3%, 92.3% shown in the infographic, labels ambiguous) are demographics only and were not scored. Membership in the Orang Rimba Social Development Partnership Forum (FKPS-SAD) is listed only as a membership table entry. Employee training table: 13,199 technical training participants and 136 orientation/leadership participants in 2025; 123,540 employee training hours. Internal communications poster and brochure design is a routine input and was not scored. No red flags are shown in the text; Human Rights Due Diligence training for internal audit staff is not a finding.
